hypothesis: Among RS90 leaders, allowing at most two closes at or above the final pivot during the preceding 20 sessions should reject worn-out resistance levels while retaining clean first-break supply release; development candidates improved on fast, medium and large-winner labels under this rule.
trial_note: Only prior pivot-cross cleanliness changes relative to the RS90 protocol. The VCP detector, stop, exit, costs, slots, universe and development interval remain frozen.
